description: This Java class implements the LoanTransferabilityService interface, providing methods to determine whether a loan transfer is possible and to get decline substatus information based on the loan's balance and transfer status.

classes.name: LoanTransferabilityServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the LoanTransferabilityService interface, handling logic for transfer eligibility and decline substatus.

methods.name: isTransferable
methods.description: Determines if a loan transfer can occur based on current balances and transfer conditions.

methods.name: getDeclinedSubStatus
methods.description: Provides the reason for decline, such as negative or zero balance.

methods.name: shouldValidateTransferable
methods.description: Internal method that checks whether the transfer validation should be enforced based on delayed settlement settings and transfer status.
